verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own marketing describes a 'Payroll AI' that collects time and attendance data, spots inconsistencies, and texts updates to the admin. That is a first-party, AI-driven insight drawn from the user's data, but it is a single marketing claim limited to anomaly-flagging in timesheet data. The standard payroll reports (docs-18) are not AI-generated and earn no credit. Missing for 10: broader AI insights or suggestions across payroll, tax, and workforce data; in-product AI recommendations beyond inconsistency alerts; detailed documentation of how the AI works; independent or hands-on corroboration.
